_comment: Canonical MeshTransportConfig for a PUBLIC mesh — the exact JSON the macOS bridge/qlinkctl should hand to qlink-core's from_json_config (FFI qlink_mesh_transport_start). meshTrustPolicy=public_required makes the connector AND responder fail closed on any peer without an active, matching Dytallix registry record; dytallixIdentity binds enforcement to the deployed quantumlink-node-registry contract on the Dytallix testnet. Replace the peer ids and rendezvousUrl with real values. See config/dytallix-testnet.json and rust/qlink-core/tests/dytallix_live.rs.
